chunks: How remote are your words from your actions!!

and how closely you resemble your paternal and maternal uncles who were led by their wickedness and love for wrong to oppose Muḥammad (may Allāh bless him and his descendants) and in consequence they were killed as you know. They could not put up a defence against the calamity and could not protect their place of safety from the striking of swords which abound in the battle and which do not show weakness.
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali compare Muawiya to the Prophet's uncles in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the hypocrisy of Muawiya by contrasting his rhetoric with his actions, drawing a parallel to the Umayyad uncles who denied Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) due to their love for falsehood. This historical analogy underscores the inevitability of their defeat, a fate Muawiya knows well, serving as a warning that his own 'defeat' will mirror theirs through decisive military and political consequences.
